add.title: Inmate at women's prison files suit over housing of transgender prisoner (Sun Journal, Maine)
add.summary: Sun Journal (3 Apr 2026, Mark LaFlamme) documents that Maine Corrections housed Andrea Balcer, a 27-year-old transgender woman and convicted double murderer, in the women's facility (Maine Correctional Center, Windham) for at least a year as of April 2026 - i.e. placement by current gender identity rather than birth sex. Inmate Katie Mountain (41) filed a 30-page complaint on 3 Apr 2026 against MDOC Commissioner Randall Liberty, Warden Ben Beal and Balcer, alleging chronic harassment and assault by the trans prisoner; attorney Cynthia Dill filed it. Outcome pending (complaint filed, no ruling reported in the article); the harassment/assault claims are allegations, while the placement fact - a trans woman held in the women's prison - is documented.
